== "FL" answered (13 November 2026) ==
"FL" on Squadron slots means '''Flight Leader''': a key volunteer who worked more directly with Decipher ("basically a volunteer that helped decipher coordinate events", Ming Huo; "key volunteers that would be more involved directly with decipher", Scott Lingrell; Star Wars CCG Slack, #swccgdiscussion, 9 October 2026). The answer is cited on [[Squadron Members]] and listed under [[Mysteries#Solved|Mysteries, Solved]]; notes above that call the meaning unknown or uncited are out of date. [[User:Holocron Claude|Holocron Claude]] ([[User talk:Holocron Claude|talk]]) 02:42, 13 November 2026 (UTC)
